```sql
WITH palm_beach_county AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Palm Beach County' AND border_type = 'county'
),
cafes_in_county AS (
  SELECT pois.geometry
  FROM pois
  JOIN palm_beach_county
    ON ST_Intersects(pois.geometry::geometry, palm_beach_county.geometry::geometry)
  WHERE pois.amenity = 'cafe'
),
nature_reserves_in_county AS (
  SELECT pois.geometry
  FROM pois
  JOIN palm_beach_county
    ON ST_Intersects(pois.geometry::geometry, palm_beach_county.geometry::geometry)
  WHERE pois.leisure = 'nature reserve'
),
cafe_elevation AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, TRUE, cafes_in_county.geometry), 1) AS elevation
  FROM cafes_in_county, public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, cafes_in_county.geometry)
),
nature_reserve_elevation AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, TRUE, nature_reserves_in_county.geometry), 1) AS elevation
  FROM nature_reserves_in_county, public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, nature_reserves_in_county.geometry)
)
SELECT 
  'cafes' AS category,
  AVG(elevation) AS avg_elevation
FROM cafe_elevation
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'nature reserves' AS category,
  AVG(elevation) AS avg_elevation
FROM nature_reserve_elevation
ORDER BY avg_elevation DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
